state-slots.json and registry-state-slots.json are copies of unicity-pos-contracts test/p85/fixtures/ at commit 7d54649d7a6bd031bd2dd51221275552d7d0b504 (branch
p85/pr1c-slots, generated by StateSlots.t.sol and RegistryStateSlots.t.sol). They record the storage slots the EVM itself reads for the
public getters, which derive_test.go reproduces from the declared layout in layout.go. registry-state-slots.json also records `progress`
(`records.progress`), the canonical progress a RejectResult proves the age of a reservation with.

publication.json is a copy of unicity-pos-contracts test/p85/fixtures/publication.json at commit 97928337a2127fc3b51ba763e6c6dbf644ed4f49 (main, #19; generated by
PublicationFixture.t.sol from the slots the EVM records with vm.accesses); primary_test.go builds the VerifyPrimary witness from those slots,
and reject_test.go the VerifyReject witness: its electionReads include Election's `roots`, `openResult` and the result's words, its
custodyReads custody's `roots`, and `reservedLost` is the reservation marked lost before any publication.

The commit named above is where each file was first copied from. The copies are kept byte-identical to unicity-pos-contracts at the commit pinned in
`xrepo/fixtures.json`, checked in CI (`xrepo/README.md`); that pin, not this file, says which contracts commit they match now.
